_about: VoltCap defect database (tools/qa). status: open | fixed (code changed, compiled) | verified (re-run on device shows it gone) | wontfix | suspect (needs evidence). Add one entry per defect; never delete — mark it.

defects.title: New category's row drawn in place for a frame on L2/R2, then jumps aside and slides in
defects.root_cause: HomeExtras.categorySlide: LaunchedEffect(tick) snapped the slide to its start only after the frame where the category changed (and then waited two more frames) — those frames drew the new row at rest, full strength.
defects.fix: graphicsLayer draws the slide's start position while the effect hasn't caught up with the tick (as StyleCrossMenu update 166).
defects.check: home_nav scenario: no transient at the R2/L2 frames; static rule SNAP-ANIMATE
defects.verified: qa_runs/r2/C_nav_frames: ev_00518, ev_00764 — no full-strength row; one empty frame (D17), then the slide

defects.title: Game info/header shown fully for one frame on every focus move, then hidden and risen in
defects.found: visual review agent (V1); consistent with run r1 ev_00572
defects.root_cause: Motion.riseOnChange: p stayed 1 in the key-change frame; snapTo(0) ran a frame later.

defects.title: 3D cases / cartridges / spines wear the previous game's picture for a frame (rememberSoftBitmap / rememberSoftLoad)
defects.fix: value tagged with its model; another model's bitmap is never returned

defects.title: Endless rows keyed by place: a category change reused the old games' slot state (old covers, old shapes resizing)
defects.fix: key = place + game key (scrolling keeps keys; a new list gets fresh slots)

defects.title: Cartridge sticker shows the game name for a frame before its cover
defects.found: visual review agent (V6); matches Toni's 'Switch cartridges first show text quickly'
